name: UK Sport on TV
description: Which UK channel shows each televised football match, weeks ahead (Sky Sports, TNT Sports, Premier Sports, BBC, ITV, Amazon…), from live-footballontv.com: added to those channels' guides at each match's time (gaps only) and kept in the plugin's settings for players such as Viewarr. Polite: refreshed after EPG refreshes at most every 6 hours, 'only if changed' requests, backs off when asked.
author: petebutty
